name: MIM-104 Patriot launching station M903 with twelve PAC-3 MSE canisters on the M860 semitrailer, coupled to its Oshkosh M983 HEMTT tractor (js/hero/us_patriot.js, HeroUsPatriot 'mse'; the same build draws nato_e80/e90/e00_sam and, through HeroUsPatriot.build, roc_e00_sam and the sam_nato_* sites)

published.source: No single published length for the M983 + M860 + M903 combination was found. 16.90 m is the travel-pose X extent of the model, tail lamp bar (x' -0.01) to the M983 bumper face (x' 16.89), measured off [S] (trailer, 64.6 px/m on the 1.30 m 16.00R20 tyre) and [U] (tractor, 72 px/m; axles 1.52 / 3.10 / 1.52 m). Height 4.33 m over the stowed stack ([T]: stack top 4.3 m). render3d sizes the unit by its visible pose, so len is that extent (it was 17.19 m, both poses together).

engine_contract.rows: HeroUsPatriot.rows (VARS): nato_e80_sam, nato_e90_sam, nato_e00_sam, sam_n; roc_artillery.js builds 'pac2' and repaints it (its own len 17.19 there); us_sam_site.js buildPatriot copies the raw build (root's direct meshes, deploypose, the turret) and sorts materials by colour, a mapped one as the skin: build() adds the turret first so the trailer skin is the last mapped material it meets
engine_contract.nodes: 'turret' (x -6.745, z 1.70, a direct child of the root) holding 'podelev' (hinge x -0.70 z 0.54 in its frame; userData.el 38 deg; userData.cells mouth x, y, z and rear x per round); 'travelpose' / 'deploypose' (outriggers and mast); six 'roadwheel' groups (four tractor, two trailer)
engine_contract.draw_calls: 16 (<= 16) either pose; tools/jsc/launcher3d_check.js and deploypose_check.js pass

must_show: a long semitrailer whose tandem sits at the TAIL (axles x -7.42 and -5.97, single 1.30 m tyres) and whose front is a raised gooseneck (deck z 1.95 .. 2.20, x -1.25 .. 1.90) over the tractor's rear pair [S][T][L]
the tall generator box on the gooseneck (x -1.04 .. 1.50, z 2.20 .. 3.85), louvred grille high on its front and starboard side [S][L][T]

the canister stack FOUR wide by THREE high, twelve single-round MSE canisters, each its own ribbed box with open X-braced end frames, dark seams between them; stowed level, its bottom z 2.45 and top z 4.30, from x -7.71 to -1.81 [E][T] and en.wikipedia ('in 3 rows of 4')
fire: the stack raised to 38 deg about the hinge over the rear axle (x -7.45, z 2.24), two long rams under it [S][L][W][K]
the LEM box under the front of the stack (x -3.90 .. -1.84, z 1.30 .. 2.12) [S][T]
four A-frame outriggers with round pads, a pair at the tail and a pair behind the gooseneck (x -1.34), down only when set up [S][L][T][W]
the data-link mast: two poles on the PORT side by the hinge (x -6.78, y 1.36), up only when set up [S][L][K]

the M983: a short flat-faced cab with a raked screen (x 6.88 .. 8.51, roof z 2.63), the louvred box and upright stack behind it, the spare lying flat, the fifth wheel over the rear pair, axles at x 0.39, 1.91, 5.00, 6.53 [U][T][P]
the cab steps hung under the doors on hangers (x 7.33 .. 8.01, z 0.70), mirrors on arms from the cab sides [U][P]

plain CARC tan over tractor, trailer and launcher frame, the MSE canisters (x -7.72 .. -1.82) a lighter tan; no markings, numbers or camouflage; team colour on the cab roof (x 7.11 .. 7.86, z 2.63) and the generator roof (x -0.50 .. 0.91, z 3.85)
